text:
Ben Park (Sales): Quick sync — trial runway update for the DeltaBank POC. Sharing updated milestones and action items. cc @Tess @Ashok @Kai @Maria. High-level ask: final staging dry-run by 03/22, customer success criteria doc by 03/25. Any blockers?

Tess Nguyen (Solutions): Thanks. Can we confirm expected success criteria? Customer wants <1s p95 for single-tenant queries and SSO+VPC for data isolation. Is that accurate?

Ashok Patel (Eng): Eng ack. Latency target seems tight for the heavy reranking path. Need to validate model variant and quantization. Also need test data from customer (sample payloads).

Maria Ortiz (SE): I'll collect payloads — pinging the customer now. Also need clarification: do they want model pinned to v1.2 or allow fallback to cheaper 8-bit variant?

Tess Nguyen (Solutions): Customer prefers pinned initially, fallback allowed during load spikes. We'll capture in success doc.

Ben Park (Sales): Who owns staging network setup (VPC peering & firewall rules)? Need owner and ETA.

Leo Kim (Infra): Infra can own VPC peering. ETA 03/20 if we get CIDR and account IDs today. Quick checklist:
```
- get customer CIDR
- get account IDs
- open firewall ports: 443, 8443, 10250
- add route for private subnet
```

Ashok Patel (Eng): For the model side, assigning QA to @ashok and @kai for inference smoke tests. Sampler command we'll run:
```
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.internal/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-open-7b-v1","input":"<customer_sample>","max_tokens":256}'
```
We need test tokens from devex.

Kai Zhou (Platform): Platform: I'll provision the staging cluster and set autoscale min=1 max=4. Need confirmation on burst policy. Also will add tracing hooks to the route.

Maria Ortiz (SE): Customer confirmed sample payloads in email thread. Uploading to shared drive: https://drive.company/DeltaBank/samples

Ben Park (Sales): Can we get a dry-run scheduled? Proposed window 03/21 10:00-11:00 PST. Who's in?

Tess Nguyen (Solutions): I'm in.

Ashok Patel (Eng): I can do it after 10:30.

Kai Zhou (Platform): 10:00 fine for infra checks, 10:30 for traffic test.

Leo Kim (Infra): I'll aim to have peering done by 03/20 EOD. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Reminder: maintenance window on prod 03/22 02:00-04:00 UTC. No staging impact expected.

Ben Park (Sales): Great — action items summary: Maria: finalize sample payloads + confirm pinned model v1.2; Leo: VPC peering by 03/20; Kai: staging cluster + autoscale by 03/19; Ashok: smoke tests + provide test token; Tess: author success criteria doc by 03/25. I'll collate into the POC tracker. If no blockers, we'll confirm dry-run 03/21 10:30 PST. Thanks all.
